limitations: These are source-grounded draft adjudication decisions for the 18 training libraries, covering all 360 supplied items through the selected review libraries. They are not model results, a frozen dataset, or human validation.

Inspected the updated MatcherFeasibility contract, original Organization project-identity requirements already read in this session, batch-02 projected inputs, and both batch02 review JSON files. Author labels, authoring files, predictions, training code and production code were not inspected.

A selection adopts the corresponding complete library from reviewer-a-batch02.json or reviewer-b-batch02.json, including its groups, relatedGroupPairs, ambiguous entries and issues. The reason here records the adjudicator's controlling interpretation; it should accompany rather than overwrite either original review.

The main reviewer disagreement outside project granularity is the boundary between a source belonging to two projects and a source relating its primary project to an existing reference. These decisions do not require a donor project to receive a new update in every possible case: they distinguish incidental attribution from actual shared procurement, physical transfer, joint inspection, or explicit comparative review using the particular source wording.

That reference-versus-membership boundary remains judgment-sensitive, especially mf01-i04, mf02-i15 and mf07-i10. The reasons expose those decisions for final review; reviewer consensus and regular authoring patterns were not used as ground truth.

Distinct object or job identifiers alone do not establish independent projects. Conversely, shared facilities, subject matter, tools or meeting slots do not establish a unified project without supported continuing identity. These judgments preserve different equipment jobs and independent trials while merging explicitly coordinated production, game, booklet and outfit work.

No source amendments are proposed here to manufacture group counts or restore bridge examples lost through correct project-level merging. Relatedness and bridge coverage must be checked across the corpus rather than imposed on each library.

Original sources and reviews are unchanged. No inference, training, model conversion, phone measurements, production changes or Git-state changes were performed. Updated test reviews and the final all-library freeze remain separate work.
